title: spring.config.import (etcd)
description: The etcd provider has no bound prefix; it is consumed via spring.config.import=optional:etcd:<host>:<port>/<key>?username=&password=&format=&dial-timeout=&retry-ms=

format.description: properties/yaml/json/toml; default inferred from the key extension, else properties

dial-timeout.description: dial timeout as a Go duration; default 5s

retry-ms.description: watcher retry interval in milliseconds; default 5000
